name: Munnar
description: A beautiful hill station in Kerala, famous for its lush tea plantations, misty mountains, and cool climate.

name: Alappuzha
description: Known as the Venice of the East, this Kerala destination is famous for its scenic backwaters, houseboats, and canals.

name: Jaipur
description: The Pink City of India, renowned for its royal palaces, historic forts, colorful markets, and rich Rajasthani culture.

name: Jodhpur
description: Known as the Blue City, it features blue-painted houses, magnificent forts, and the impressive Mehrangarh Fort.

name: Kochi
description: The Queen of the Arabian Sea, famous for its historic Fort Kochi, Chinese fishing nets, colonial architecture, and vibrant culture.

name: Paris
description: The City of Love, celebrated for the Eiffel Tower, world-class museums, elegant streets, and romantic atmosphere.

name: Venice
description: The Floating City of Italy, famous for its picturesque canals, gondola rides, historic buildings, and charming bridges.

name: New York City
description: Known as the Big Apple, it is a vibrant metropolis featuring Times Square, Central Park, the Statue of Liberty, and world-famous entertainment.

name: Dubai
description: A modern destination known for its luxurious shopping malls, Burj Khalifa, desert safaris, and spectacular architecture.

name: Singapore
description: The Lion City, famous for its modern skyline, Gardens by the Bay, Marina Bay Sands, clean streets, and diverse cuisine.
